title: Compyla conformance case
description: case.json in every fixture directory (see README.md).

spec.description: The spec sections and change IDs this fixture covers, e.g. ["§9.3", "C12"].

oracle.description: prototype: expected.json is generated from the TypeScript prototype and must equal its output. corrected: the spec deliberately corrects the prototype; expected.json is hand-written and the oracle checks the prototype really differs. none: the prototype can't produce this output; hand-written.

format.description: Target format. Required for lint, compose and render suites.

assets.description: Image sources the asset resolver resolves. Omitted: every source resolves (markdown-spec.md §10.3).

template.description: Lint and render suites: a template file in the fixture directory, passed as the template option. Inspect suite: the template file to inspect.
